title: Bug Report? DatePicker widget errors on changing dates
body: I am running a bokeh server app on 0.11.1. I am creating a DatePicker widget as follows: ``` python beginning = DatePicker(title="Begin Date", min_date=datetime(2014,11,1), max_date=datetime.now(), value=datetime(datetime.now().year,1,1) ) ``` I am running the app as follows: `bokeh serve --show usage_app.py` The DatePicker loads properly and displays as expected in the app. I have tested the default value, and it properly sets a default value of 2016-01-01, I have tried it using strings and datetime objects, both of which work. The issue is on changing dates. When I select a new date or try to change the month on the calendar display it immediately errors out and changes to a different, more primitive display. In order to be exhaustive, I have tried declaring the object with and without mind and max dates. and I still reproduce the same error. Here is the stack trace: ``` ERROR:bokeh.server.protocol.server_handler:error handling message Message 'PATCH-DOC' (revision 1): ValueError('expected a date, string or timestamp, got {}',) I was following the 0.11 reference on widgets.
